label: digit 0 input during the original phase
explanation: Fires whenever the input token is the digit 0 during the original (pre-<DEL>) phase, at any position and for any L; precision 1.0 and recall ~0.999 on dev. Almost all mass is here, with a trace of ~150 weak activations in the copy phase at recall_idx 1-2. It never fires on any other token, on the <DEL> step, or on 0 when 0 is fed back as input during the copy phase. Magnitude is highest when 0 is the first token or appears early in the sequence (top examples reach max ~2.95 at t=0). It is lower for a second or repeated 0 (about 0.75-0.86 of max), and lowest when the 0 is the last original token just before <DEL> (lowest-quartile examples are all at to_go=0).

issues: Minor, not systematic: on test, 145 of 108,855 active steps are missed and 0 are false positives. All 145 misses are copy-phase steps where the token being fed back is 0, at about 0.01-0.02 of max, and they hold 0.0% of activation mass. The claim that it never fires on 0 fed back during the copy phase is slightly too strong: it fires there extremely weakly.

The magnitude claims match the profile. Top examples are all at t=0 with value 1.0. A second or repeated 0 sits around 0.74-0.88 of max. The lowest-quartile examples shown are all 0s right before <DEL> (to_go=0), at 0.22-0.55 of max. Mass share falls steadily with t.
